description: All three B0 application workloads under xv6, complete, driven through the PRODUCTION lifecycle with the workload-profile delta applied, against the accepted simulator standing in as the board-side host. Supersedes the partial run of 2026-09-22, which is retained: it timed out on b0file and its disk was not fresh.

artifacts.note: the kernel is byte-identical to the accepted simulation run's; only the disk carries the three extra user programs

disk_freshness.policy: each sample gets a fresh copy of the same initial disk image
disk_freshness.detail: the runner copies the pristine image before each sample; disk at start equals the pristine B0 hash

frequency.caution: wall time here is SIMULATOR wall time and measures the simulator, not the CPU

sample_policy.shortfall_note: one sample. A second would cost another ~6.4 h of simulation; the policy is met by repetition, which has not been done.

timeouts.sizing: taken from the measured partial run, which reached 45% of b0file in 7200 s

metrics_note: target-side cycles are null for application workloads by contract; a user program cannot read mcycle without kernel changes made for measurement convenience
